chosen_after.reason: Accepted high exploration leaves a selected optimistic suboptimal mean with few visits in these exposed cases. Test staged sampling that spends more of the same root allowance on surviving arms.

diagnostic_api.coordinates: JSON dictionaries {card_idx,target_idx}, no labels used for identity
diagnostic_api.phases: active action coordinates, quota, completed samples, phase-local sums/means, survivors at elimination
diagnostic_api.work_units: selections/reward_updates/elimination key evaluations are arithmetic accounting; all simulator samples counted in existing last_sims,last_transitions including first coverage and remainder; no claims of exact machine instruction count

final_rule.fallback: sampled mean then visits then canonical physical order; unsampled legal actions remain explicitly unsampled in study rows
final_rule.halving: completed final survivor first; all other sampled physical actions retained and ordered by raw cumulative mean, visits, canonical physical order
final_rule.identity: candidate-dependent selection/ties are part of treatment; not an allocation-only causal estimate or PR48 selector sweep

gate: candidate source, wrapper and boundary acceptance frozen separately before deciding collection; original protocol and data freeze remain unchanged
publication: private prototype only unless frozen promote criteria and review/CI/installed/affected-public acceptance justify delivery; no public consumer source-map loosening now

schedule.elimination: retain ceil(active_count/2) greatest phase-local binary64 means; exact sampled-mean ties use canonical physical order; no epsilon/no reference
schedule.minimum: sum of survivor counts K,ceil(K/2),... down to2; when budget insufficient use uniform round-robin fallback without elimination
schedule.phase: r is number of remaining ceil-half rounds; q=max(1,floor(remaining_allowance/(r*active_count))); each active arm sampled q times in canonical round-robin; phase-local sums and counts only
schedule.physical_actions: existing canonical legal action order; coordinates include separate duplicate card slots, targets and Pass; compare current availability each simulation
schedule.remainder: after a single survivor, spend all remaining samples on it; no hidden initialization or test draws
schedule.usable_allowance: min(max_sims,max_transitions) if transitions supplied, else max_sims; h1 each completed sample one transition

scope.source: isolated actual existing MCTS.search; only root edge choice and explicit final treatment differ
scope.theory: Named budget-aware variant motivated by sequential halving, not the published theorem or a full-encounter claim
